fixed_operating_materials.goal_spec: Translate ECC agent, command, skill, and hook conventions into OpenCode plugin/config form.
fixed_operating_materials.issue_decomposition: Install/configure plugin, load agents and instructions, map hooks/events, run command or quality gate.
fixed_operating_materials.tech_report: Report agent role, command/hook execution, plugin event mapping, quality-gate result, and configuration constraints.
fixed_operating_materials.supervisor_decision_record: Hold broad orchestration; continue only scoped config/plugin dry-run and review.

vectorfl_translation.external_candidate_search_brief: Use OpenCode as a worker-input and hook-event reference, not as a full multi-worker architecture.
vectorfl_translation.candidate_evidence_record: Represent one OpenCode command/plugin event as issue/run/result/governance surfaces.
vectorfl_translation.cross_check_review_report: Check whether plugin/hook evidence helps review readiness without replacing the current anchor.
vectorfl_translation.hold_continue_decision_manifest: Hold gate close because the reference is a CLI/config system, not a host export.
